hero.edit: assembled mask, slow deployment, whole board, staged local flex assembly, whole face cushion, magnetic closure, charging rest

local_sequence: ear flex returns around 10 mm outer padding stand-off
pcb.smt: rigid components mounted using the same deformation and its local tangent frame; no individual flights, random rotations or collision-push simulation
pcb.native_plating: all plating uses the same rest coordinates and one canonical deformation
pcb.interactive: one substrate and peripheral ribbons; simplified trace detail; 180 rigid component mounts

surface.foam: fine grey-black porous variation, no stripes or ridges; original cushion silhouette
surface.fabric: isotropic fine grain in fixed 3D rest-surface coordinates; logo in undeformed UVs
surface.logo: raised above nose while retaining an upper margin

charging.orientation: logo side down, sides folded upward
charging.indicator: smooth cosine pulse, matching value and slope at loop boundary

signals.history: write once per sample; trace vertices use fixed acquisition timestamps
signals.events: colored duration bars for K-complexes and spindles, attached to their recorded segments

controls: continuous motion while visible; system reduced-motion preference respected
